with e as (select l.person_key p,l.issue_key i,i.project_key pr,l.history_id h,l.seconds s from model.logged_time l join model.issue i using(issue_key) where l.seconds>0 and l.logged_at>='2009-07-01+00' and l.logged_at<'2009-10-01+00'),
el as (select p from e group by p having count(distinct pr)>=2),
t as (select p,sum(s) v from e where p in (select p from el) group by p),
r as (select p,v,rank() over(order by v desc) rk from t)
select e.p,e.i,e.pr,e.h,r.v from e join r on r.p=e.p where rk<=5 order by r.v desc,e.p
